title: Embedding Content
description: Learn how to embed external content such as videos, maps, and other media using HTML.

flashcards.question: What HTML tag is commonly used to embed another webpage or document?
How do you embed a YouTube video in an HTML page?
flashcards.answer: Using an <iframe> tag with the YouTube video URL as the src attribute.

flashcards.question: What attributes are important for the <iframe> tag?
flashcards.answer: src, width, height, allowfullscreen, frameborder, and title.

flashcards.question: What is the purpose of the <embed> tag?
flashcards.answer: It embeds external content like PDFs, videos, or Flash files.

flashcards.question: How is the <object> tag different from <embed>?
flashcards.answer: The <object> tag is more versatile and can contain fallback content if the embedded resource fails to load.

flashcards.question: Can you embed Google Maps in a webpage? If yes, how?
flashcards.answer: Yes, by copying the embed code from Google Maps and placing it inside an <iframe>.

flashcards.question: What attribute controls whether an iframe allows fullscreen?
Are there any security concerns with using <iframe>?
flashcards.answer: Yes, including potential cross-site scripting (XSS) and clickjacking risks, mitigated by sandboxing and Content Security Policy.

flashcards.question: What does the sandbox attribute do in an iframe?
flashcards.answer: It imposes restrictions on the content inside the iframe for better security.
